description: Source code defining the LKJCholesky distribution class for sampling and computing log probabilities of Cholesky factors of correlation matrices, based on the Onion method, within the PyTorch framework.

classes.name: LKJCholesky
classes.description: A distribution class for the LKJ distribution over the Cholesky factors of correlation matrices, supporting sampling and log probability calculations.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the LKJCholesky distribution with specified dimension and concentration parameters.

methods.name: expand
methods.description: Expands the distribution to a new batch shape.

methods.name: sample
methods.description: Generates samples of the Cholesky factor using the Onion method.

methods.name: log_prob
methods.description: Calculates the log probability of a given Cholesky factor.
